When your furnace stops working on a freezing January night, you need a team that answers the phone and gets the heat back on. J&M Cooling and Heating is a locally owned, family-owned HVAC company that provides furnace repair in Fairfield, NJ for homeowners who want honest answers and quality work. We find the problem, explain it clearly, and fix it right.

North Jersey winters put real demands on your heating system. Cold snaps, snowstorms, and long stretches of below-freezing temperatures mean your furnace runs for hours at a time. All that extra work wears down parts and exposes small problems that may have gone unnoticed during milder months. Catching those issues early helps keep your family warm and avoids bigger repair bills down the road.

WARNING SIGNS YOUR FURNACE NEEDS ATTENTION

Your furnace often lets you know something is wrong before it shuts down completely. Watch for these common warning signs.

Cold air from vents
Uneven heat between rooms
Banging or rattling noises
Burning or unusual smells
Frequent on and off cycling
Yellow or flickering burner flame
Rising heating bills
Thermostat not responding

If you notice any of these signs, schedule service as soon as possible. If you ever smell gas, leave your home right away and call your gas utility or 911 from a safe location.

SCHEDULE SERVICE
CALL 862-319-8808
FURNACE PROBLEMS WE FIX MOST OFTEN

Many furnace issues start with airflow. A clogged air filter restricts the flow of air through the system, which can cause the furnace to overheat and shut itself off as a safety measure. Blocked vents and dirty blower components can lead to the same problem and leave parts of your home feeling cold.

Ignition and flame sensor problems are also common. Over time, a flame sensor can get coated with buildup and stop detecting the flame, which causes the furnace to shut off shortly after starting. Igniters can crack or wear out, especially in systems that run long hours during cold Fairfield winters.

We also repair worn blower motors, faulty limit switches, thermostat issues, and electrical problems. Older furnaces may develop issues with the heat exchanger, which can be a safety concern. Our technicians check for these problems carefully so you know your system is running safely and efficiently.

SCHEDULE SERVICE
CALL 862-319-8808
HOW WE GET YOUR FURNACE RUNNING AGAIN

Every repair starts with listening. We ask what you’ve noticed, when the problem started, and whether the furnace has been acting differently lately. That information helps our technician narrow down the cause quickly.

Next, we inspect your system from top to bottom. We check the thermostat, ignition system, flame sensor, burners, blower, filter, electrical connections, and safety controls. Once we find the root cause, we explain what’s wrong in plain terms and give you an upfront price before any work begins.

With your approval, we make the repair using quality parts and test the furnace through a full heating cycle. We confirm it’s running safely and keeping your home at the right temperature. Before we leave, we’ll let you know about anything else we noticed so you can plan ahead for future furnace repair in Fairfield, NJ or routine maintenance.

SCHEDULE SERVICE
CALL 862-319-8808
24/7 EMERGENCY FURNACE REPAIR

Furnace breakdowns don’t wait for a convenient time, and neither do we. J&M Cooling and Heating offers 24/7 emergency service, so you can reach us on nights, weekends, and holidays. A home without heat during a New Jersey cold snap can quickly become uncomfortable and even unsafe for young children, older family members, and pets.

Freezing temperatures can also put your plumbing at risk if your home stays cold for too long. Our team responds quickly, tracks down the problem, and works to restore heat as fast as possible. When your furnace quits in the middle of the night, give us a call.

TWO GUYS, ONE TRUCK, AND A PROMISE TO DO IT RIGHT

Every HVAC company will tell you they care about quality. Fewer can point back to the exact year, the exact town, and the two guys who started it all.

J&M Cooling/Heating began in 2006, when Mike Lipesky and John Falco formed the company in Caldwell, NJ. They weren’t trying to build a franchise. They were trying to build something simpler: a heating and cooling company that showed up when it said it would, did the job correctly, and treated every home like it mattered.

That idea turned out to be the whole business plan. It still is.

SCHEDULE SERVICE
CALL 862-319-8808
FROM A LOCAL STARTUP TO A TRUSTED NAME

Since 2008, J&M has been based in Northern NJ, growing steadily across Central and Northern New Jersey. There was no big marketing push behind that growth. There was no gimmick. There was just work, done well, one job at a time.

Homeowners told neighbors. Neighbors told the family. Property managers told other property managers. That’s how J&M became one of the most trusted commercial, industrial, and residential HVAC contractors in the state, not through claims of being the biggest or the flashiest, but through a track record customers were willing to stand behind.

Today, J&M’s reputation for 100% client satisfaction is still the foundation the business runs on. It’s not a tagline. It’s the standard every technician is held to on every call.

SCHEDULE SERVICE
CALL 862-319-8808
WHAT WE DO

J&M handles the full range of heating, cooling, and refrigeration needs for homes and businesses across the region.

Residential Services
From repairs to full installations to routine maintenance, J&M keeps homes across Central and Northern NJ comfortable, no matter the season.
Commercial Installations
We provide turnkey HVAC services for businesses of every size, from small local shops to major companies, with the same attention to detail on every job.
Gas & Water Piping
Our team includes highly trained piping specialists who bring exact precision to every install, backed by Trac-Pipe certification and FlashShield gas piping expertise.
Rooftop HVAC
Larger buildings need heavier systems. J&M installs and maintains rooftop HVAC units for commercial properties that can't afford downtime.
SCHEDULE SERVICE
CALL 862-319-8808
THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE WORK

A company is only as good as the people who show up to do the work, and that’s where J&M has always focused its energy.

Every technician on our team is NATE-certified, meaning they’ve met a national standard for technical knowledge, not just a company-issued badge. We hold an NJ Master HVAC license, full EPA Universal Certification, and additional credentials, including City Multi certification and qualifications for public works contracting. We service all major brands, including Trane, Carrier, Bryant, Goodman, Amana, Daikin, York, and many more, so no matter what system is in your home or building, our team knows how to work on it.

None of these credentials exists to impress anyone. They exist so that when a technician is in your home or on your rooftop, you can trust that the work is being done correctly, safely, and to code.

SCHEDULE SERVICE
CALL 862-319-8808
A REPUTATION BUILT ONE JOB AT A TIME

Ask around Central or Northern NJ, and you’ll likely hear a story similar to this one, from a customer in Little Falls, NJ:

“Mike, the M of J&M, came out on the call. He was great, professional, and got the job done. Will probably have him do maintenance next on our AC system. I was very pleased.”
Elizabeth S., Little Falls, NJ

Stories like this one aren’t the exception at J&M. They’re the expectation. When the founder of the company is still the one showing up on service calls, that tells you something about how seriously this business takes its own name.

SCHEDULE SERVICE
CALL 862-319-8808
SERVING CENTRAL AND NORTHERN NEW JERSEY

J&M proudly serves homeowners and businesses throughout Central and Northern New Jersey, including Sussex, Passaic, Bergen, Warren, Morris, Essex, Hudson, Hunterdon, Somerset, Union, and Middlesex counties. Wherever you are in our service area, you’re getting the same team, the same standards, and the same commitment that’s defined J&M since day one.

And because HVAC emergencies don’t wait for convenient timing, we offer 24/7/365 emergency service. A broken furnace in January or a failed AC system in July gets the same urgency from our team, day or night.

SCHEDULE SERVICE
CALL 862-319-8808
WHY IT STILL MATTERS

Businesses change over time. Owners retire. Companies get bought out. Priorities shift.

What hasn’t changed at J&M is the reason Mike and John started the company in the first place: to build something homeowners and businesses could actually rely on. Not the biggest name in New Jersey HVAC. Not the loudest. Just a company that keeps its word, sends technicians who know what they’re doing, and treats every job like it’s the one that matters most, because to the person on the other end of that service call, it is.

That’s the story of J&M Cooling/Heating. It started with two guys and a truck in Caldwell, NJ, and it continues today with every technician who walks into a customer’s home carrying that same commitment forward.

SCHEDULE SERVICE
CALL 862-319-8808
COME EXPERIENCE THE J&M DIFFERENCE

We pride ourselves on quality work and craftsmanship on every project we take on. If you’re looking for a heating and cooling partner you can trust, one built on decades of hands-on experience and a genuine commitment to doing things right, we’d be glad to earn that trust with you.

Contact J&M Cooling/Heating today, and see what a company built on its own reputation looks like in action.
